verdict.rationale: Jules runs each task in a cloud virtual machine where it clones the repo, installs dependencies, and modifies files. Changes reach the real codebase only through a reviewed diff or PR, and plans can require approval first, so work is isolated from production. A hands-on user confirms the cloud-VM execution model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running test suites inside the VM, any statement on isolating production data or secrets, and configurable sandbox or test environments.
